sealed_statement.Q_ALL: On all still-dynamic U=X union Y and one node [C] per residual Y0 component, copy G[U] exactly, keep component nodes independent, and put u-[C] iff u is complete to C.
sealed_statement.lift: Every induced P_k in Q_ALL lifts to an induced P_k in G for every k>=1.
sealed_statement.scope_strengthening: No fixed B0 coarse class is needed.
sealed_statement.coupling: Every residual Y0 component in the post-seed-two state has a nonempty dynamic complete-neighbor set D_C.
